reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reread the programme appendix, assessment and catalogue evidence for the 2026 entrant. Reconsidered the strongest UCR course contributions and whether the repaired schedules support the pedagogy and education focus before inspecting the exact external-only record.
findings: The broad route totals 180 EC and develops pedagogy and education from the first-year foundations through family, policy and effectiveness, research workshops and practice. The practicum requirements share 5 EC. Internship is 5 EC and thesis is 10 EC. The 60 first-year plus 40 later credits gate is satisfied in the ordinary progression.

The strongest feasible trial gives substantial child development, research, school climate and school rhetoric practice, and adds education policy. The orthopedagogical trial adds assessment, psychopathology, family therapy and health. Those courses make real contributions without collectively sustaining inquiry into upbringing, parenting and educational practice and evaluation. The teaching direction also lacks subject didactics and supervised classroom progression.

The conclusion is unchanged when offering conflicts are resolved. The record presents the entire 31-component external curriculum with the minor, workshop choices and thesis rule, and shows no UCR options.
